create_simulation_server: create a SimulationServer instance on a custom port with HTML content for visualization
start_simulation_server: start the SimulationServer HTTP server in a background thread for real-time simulation control
broadcast_step_data: broadcast step data to all connected SSE clients with entity actions and logs
set_simulation_instance: set the simulation instance on the server to enable dynamic component state editing
stop_simulation_server: stop the running SimulationServer HTTP server and join its background thread
